identificationModule.briefTitle: Compare Bosutinib To Imatinib In Subjects With Newly Diagnosed Chronic Phase Philadelphia Chromosome Positive CML
identificationModule.officialTitle: A PHASE 3 RANDOMIZED, OPEN-LABEL STUDY OF BOSUTINIB VERSUS IMATINIB IN SUBJECTS WITH NEWLY DIAGNOSED CHRONIC PHASE PHILADELPHIA CHROMOSOME POSITIVE CHRONIC MYELOGENOUS LEUKEMIA

interventions.name: Bosutinib
interventions.description: 500 mg once daily, by mouth (tablet) with food preferably in the morning. Drug can be increased up to 600mg daily in case of lack of efficacy, and can be reduced to 300mg daily in case of toxicity. The drug will be given daily for up to 8 years until treatment failure, unacceptable toxicity, death or withdrawal of consent.

interventions.name: imatinib
interventions.description: 400 mg once daily, by mouth (tablet). Drug can be increased up to 600mg daily in case of lack of efficacy, and can be reduced to 300mg daily in case of toxicity. The drug will be given daily for up to 8 years until treatment failure, unacceptable toxicity, death or withdrawal of consent.
